'''Dathomiri spider [[Silk/Legends|silk]]''' was a type of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] and material used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Silk was taken from the local [[Spider/Legends|spiders]] and could be used to craft a light yet durable texture that was used in most of the [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] worn by the [[Witches of Dathomir|indigenous Witches]]. Balls of spider silk were also used as a [[Currency/Legends|currency]] for trade amongst the Witches.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Spider Silk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dathomiri spider silk appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment.<ref name="SWG" /> The use of a natural product as a commodity money amongst the Witches of Dathomir mirrors the real-world system of [[Wikipedia:Commodity money|commodity money]] developed in early cultures all over the world.
